title: DC-area forecast: A couple storms possible this evening and Monday. Tuesday storms may be intense.
contentHtml:
Always a human at the helm: Updated around-the-clock by Capital Weather meteorologists.

Happening now: A couple showers and thunderstorms are possible this evening through around midnight. Evening 70s dip to lows within a few degrees of 65.

What's next? Heat and humidity increase a bit more Monday with a late-day shower or storm chance. A few storms could be strong to severe on Tuesday.

Forecast in detail

Tonight: A couple of showers and a rumble of thunder are possible through around midnight. Otherwise, skies are partly cloudy with light winds. Humidity increases a bit as lows settle within a few degrees of 65. Confidence: Medium-High

Tomorrow (Monday): Feeling a bit more like July with highs in the mid-80s to near 90 and somewhat higher humidity (dew points in the mid- to upper 60s). A good amount of sun before the chance of a few showers or storms, mainly mid- to late afternoon. Confidence: Medium

Hourly Forecast | Pollen, Air & UV

Tomorrow night: A couple of showers or storms still possible into the evening. Otherwise mostly cloudy and muggy with lows in the upper 60s to low 70s. Confidence: Medium

📬 Get our forecast in your inbox

Our morning forecast email is back! It's included with every level of support — from Free to Sustainer — delivered 7 days a week. Sign up at: capitalweather.com/support-us

A look ahead

Tuesday should bring the week’s highest chance for more widespread showers and thunderstorms as a disturbance passes nearby. If we get enough midday sun, there's a chance for some strong to severe storms during the afternoon into evening, with potential for damaging winds, hail, and locally heavy rainfall. Highs should reach somewhere from near 80 to near 90 depending on cloud cover, and it's rather humid. Tuesday night lows in the mid- to upper 60s. Confidence: Medium

Decreasing rain chances and increasing sun early Wednesday, though an isolated shower or storm remains possible during the afternoon into evening. Highs climb to the mid- to upper 80s with moderate humidity. Wednesday night lows in the mid-60s. Confidence: Low-Medium

High pressure starts to build in Thursday. Skies should be at least partly sunny, with highs in the mid-80s to near 90 and low to moderate humidity. Confidence: Low-Medium

Today’s daily digit — 8/10: Comfortable temperatures, manageable humidity, and substantial sunshine make for a great late-July day. Enjoy! | 🤚 Your call?
The digit is a somewhat subjective rating of the day’s weather, on a 0-to-10 scale.

DC weather history for July 26

A historic 1897 deluge in Maryland set a state 24-hour rainfall record, with torrential rains devastating roads, farms, and low-lying areas.
